entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
entities.description: A substate of 5GMM-DEREGISTERED chosen when N1 mode is enabled and the UE has no valid subscriber data available.

entities.name: N1 mode enabled
entities.description: Condition where the UE has N1 mode enabled.

entities.name: No valid subscriber data available
entities.description: Condition where the UE has no valid subscriber data (USIM not available, USIM invalid, or invalid SNPN entry in list of subscriber data).

relations.description: The substate requires N1 mode to be enabled.
The substate requires that no valid subscriber data is available.
